name: GIAC Experienced Forensics Examiner
name_ja: GIAC エクスペリエンスド・フォレンジック・エグザミナー

logistics.format: Applied Knowledge tier; 1 proctored open-book CyberLive exam (hands-on, real-world practical testing)

recommended_certs.rationale: FOR500 起点の GCFE → 高度 DFIR の GCFA を経た学習者にとって、GX-FE は CyberLive 特化の総合実技評価として位置付けられる。
GIAC は本認証を 'GCFE certification holders who have gained additional experience' を主たる対象として位置付け。GCFE のホスト/Windows フォレンジック土台のうえに Applied Knowledge 層として GX-FE が積まれる構造。

plus.note: 25 問 4 時間が全て CyberLive 実機課題で構成される Applied Knowledge 層。
FOR500 を主軸に FOR498/FOR508/FOR608 の知見を横断する上位評価。
GCFE 経験者を主対象に設計された GIAC Applied Knowledge / Experienced 層。

minus.note: 2023-2024 年に始まった Applied Knowledge シリーズで、求人要件としての浸透はこれから。
前提となる SANS FOR500/FOR508 等の受講で総額 $8,000 級になりやすい。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Four hours of practical evidence tasks across several forensic disciplines support expert examination at five years; recent rollout weakens hiring recognition but not the recorded breadth and depth of assessment.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Four hours of wholly practical forensic tasks spanning several established disciplines provide strong expert hiring evidence. Accreditation and the five-year profile support senior depth, while limited uptake and cost constrain recognition and access.

alex-novak.rationale: The record describes four hours entirely of CyberLive tasks, drawing on several forensic disciplines beyond the base examiner credential. That advanced applied breadth supports expert forensic practice despite the five-year profile and limited market uptake.
